tasks.description: Fix normalize_label(value) in label_utils.py to satisfy the repository contract. Before editing, inspect both label_utils.py and CONTRACT.md; do not guess the contract. Run the tests before finishing.

files.CONTRACT.md:
# Label contract

normalize_label(value) must trim outer whitespace, lowercase the text, collapse each run of internal whitespace to a single hyphen, and return an empty string for whitespace-only input.
files.tests/test_label_utils.py:
from label_utils import normalize_label


def test_normalize_label():
    assert normalize_label('  Hello   Agent  ') == 'hello-agent'
    assert normalize_label('   ') == ''

command: from label_utils import normalize_label; assert normalize_label('  Hello   Agent  ') == 'hello-agent'; assert normalize_label('   ') == ''

tasks.description: Fix retry_delay(attempt) in retry_policy.py to match SPEC.md. Before editing, inspect both retry_policy.py and SPEC.md; do not infer the rule from the function name. Run the tests before finishing.

files.SPEC.md:
# Retry policy

retry_delay(attempt) returns zero for attempt <= 0. For positive attempts it returns powers of two starting at 1: attempt 1 -> 1, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 4, 4 -> 8.
files.tests/test_retry_policy.py:
from retry_policy import retry_delay


def test_retry_delay():
    assert retry_delay(0) == 0
    assert retry_delay(1) == 1
    assert retry_delay(2) == 2
    assert retry_delay(4) == 8

command: from retry_policy import retry_delay; assert retry_delay(0) == 0; assert retry_delay(1) == 1; assert retry_delay(2) == 2; assert retry_delay(4) == 8
